name: latex
description: Render TeX math, TikZ diagrams and LaTeX blocks in Claude Code's desktop app, in any of 10 LaTeX fonts, with every LaTeX compile sandboxed

mathFont.title: Math font
mathFont.description: mathjax draws instantly in Computer Modern. Any other choice typesets every formula with your local LaTeX in that font, showing MathJax until it is ready.

colorScheme.title: Math color
colorScheme.description: auto follows the system light or dark setting. Pick light or dark if the app's theme differs from the system's.

tikz.title: Compile LaTeX blocks
tikz.description: Compile ```tikz, ```tikzcd and ```latex code blocks with your local TeX install (latex and dvisvgm).

userMarkdown.title: Full rendered copy of your messages
userMarkdown.description: Under your message bubble, show the whole message rendered: Markdown and math. Off by default, since it repeats your text.

userMessages.title: Math under your messages
userMessages.description: Under your message bubble, show the math and diagrams from your message, rendered.

copyButton.title: Copy TeX button
copyButton.description: Show a Copy TeX button under each display formula and LaTeX block.

macrosFile.title: Macros file
macrosFile.description: A .tex file of \newcommand and \DeclareMathOperator lines applied to every formula.
